core_definition: The existing frozen 58-school Marketing scope; all research tracks, industry outcomes and unclassified people retained.
priority_definition: Continue the fourteen programs already under active review, with Berkeley and Kellogg discrepancies first. This is a work order, not a new ranking or a completeness claim.
stop_rule: An unresolved cell remains open with its exact evidence gap and next action. A failed access attempt, search result or ceremony-candidate list does not close an awarded-degree cohort.
ordering: Named count/identity conflicts, then the fixed priority programs, then core ranking order; newest unresolved year first within each program. Never drop a school-year because it has no collected people.
invariants: Marketing and Economics/IO subset populations remain separate.
A published class, completion window, calendar conferral census and market season are different populations.
Source roster year, graduation year and first-job start year remain independent.
A complete roster with unclassified members does not establish a complete Quant subset.
All 58 core schools remain visible, including eligibility exceptions.
